body.message:
Please note that we are unable to block or hold the unit without receiving payment. However, for Elite Business Bay Residence, we do not accept payment in advance before the viewing.

We kindly ask for your patience and understanding, as the unit will be available for viewing from 17 August. Once the viewing has been completed and you are satisfied with the apartment, we will proceed with the payment and confirm the booking accordingly.

Please note that this is our standard procedure for all guests, and we do not confirm bookings for this property without a prior viewing.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
